highlights.title: Needs attention takes you straight to the ask
highlights.text: Click a Needs-attention row and kwant opens the right chat at the exact ask. A Needs you bar above the message box says it in full with one button, and the row clears itself once it's handled.

highlights.title: Closed browser steps say what they were
highlights.text: Once a sign-in or human check in the browser is done, skipped or timed out, its card is headed by a quiet grey name like Sign-in instead of still saying Sign in needed.

fixes: Bots on API engines can read the files in their own folder (read_file and list_dir), and nothing outside it.
A desktop setting that can't be saved keeps its old value and says "kwant couldn't save the change. Check that ~/.kwnt can be written."
kwnt's server and command line install on Mac and Linux with `brew install alexsergivan/kwant/kwnt`.
Bots no longer lose their browser after a long day: kwant closes the browser connections it isn't using (thanks @calintro, #753).
Home Assistant's read-only tools run without asking in "Ask only when risky", and a home-network http sign-in says to use a token header.
A Deploy to Render button and ready files for CasaOS, Umbrel and Coolify; a store install's sign-in screen says where its password is.
A customer's or another bot's message now sits on the left in an outlined bubble, so only your own messages sit on your side.
